title: ASD LabSpec 4 high-res -> standard-res, v0.2 (blur per detector, then absorbance gain per detector; provisional)

operator.note: inside each detector segment of the scan's own joins (the join wavelength belongs to the lower segment); taps to radius ceil(4 sigma), renormalised within the segment, never crossing a join; sigma from the published bandwidths (FWHM 10 nm standard vs 6 nm high-res in SWIR; VNIR equal)

A = log10(1/max(R, 1e-6)); A' = g*A + c per detector segment (VNIR, SWIR1, SWIR2); R' = 10^(-A'). The offsets only keep the displayed absorbance continuous at the training joins; every derivative-based output ignores them.

provenance.summary: Transfer v0.2 (provisional): nominal Gaussian blur per detector, then a per-detector absorbance gain. The high-res instrument records collagen-related second-derivative features about 1.6x deeper than the standard instrument (an absorbance gain, not resolution); the two SWIR detectors need different gains.
provenance.fitted_on: 40 paired scans of the same archaeological bones on a high-resolution and a standard-resolution LabSpec 4 (two unit pairs, 20 pairs each; spots not marked, so pairs are not same-spot); 4 discordant pairs excluded from every fit and statistic (36 concordant pairs)
provenance.estimator: least squares of the 36-pair MEAN SG31 cubic second derivative of absorbance (standard vs blurred high-res), one gain per SWIR detector (ratio of means: targets the average, immune to zero-mean spot differences); VNIR gain kept at the v0.1 value 0.6343 (not fitted; only the burnt-bone visible-edge check reads it)

fit_range_nm.note: SWIR2 refit (Phase 0b) on centres whose SG31 and blur support lie inside 1820-2300 nm: the > 2300 nm tail is noise on dark high-res scans and no longer enters the fit. The earlier 1820-2350 nm fit gave 0.6284; without the tail 0.6258 (-0.4%, about 1/12 of the between-unit spread); fitted on the support-limited range 1835-2285 nm (SG only) 0.6264.

gain_by_unit_pair.note: fitted on one unit pair alone; the 5-8% spread between units is why the transfer is provisional and per-lab (serial-keyed) transfer files are allowed

provenance.offsets: continuity offsets: c_SWIR1 = 0.2312 + (g_VNIR - g_SWIR1) * A(1000), c_SWIR2 = c_SWIR1 + (g_SWIR1 - g_SWIR2) * A(1800), with the median blurred high-res absorbance A(1000) = 0.3380, A(1800) = 0.4798; display only
provenance.why_blur: the blur reduces output noise (x0.55-0.87) and spectrum noise (4-10x); gain-only biased the collagen models (+0.9 points) and lowered sign agreement

accepted_exception.decision: accepted provisional exception (release gate: <= 8% for C-H 1689, 5% for every other band). Its effect on the evidence level is about -0.17 u at the 'clear' boundary, below the 0.25 u can't-tell limit.

limits: unit-to-unit spread 5-8% (one transfer per class until a calibration kit gives per-lab files)
per-scan scatter about 2 points between paired scans; the spots differ, so only the mean bias is a metric
the offsets guarantee nothing at joins other than 1000/1800 nm; consumers whose kernel crosses a join are not assessed (grid-eligibility rule)

validation.pairs: 36 concordant scan pairs; cross-unit = gains fitted on one unit pair, tested on the other; all-36 = the shipped gains on every pair
validation.gain_sensitivity: under a +-7% gain error, ranks, sorts, the lit strip, the ZooMS pattern and B9 do not change; evidence levels flip on 0.5-3.6% of scans; collagen % values move about +-0.5-0.6 points
